import sys, json, itertools
sys.path.insert(0, '/workspace/tests')
from lib import *

c = itertools.count()
def s(sid, off, h, fin=False): return F("STREAM", id=sid, offset=off, data_hex=h, fin=fin)
def P(): return F("PING")
def CL(app, code): return F("CLOSE", app=app, code=code)
def HD(): return F("HANDSHAKE_DONE")
def d(packs, t, size=1200): return dg(t, size, packs)
def p(*frames, level="A", pn=None, auth=True): return pkt(level, next(c) if pn is None else pn, list(frames), auth)
def K(t,lvl,act): return key(t,lvl,act)

# error in the first packet of a datagram (Z level), rest dropped
v = view(one([K(0,"A","install"), d([p(s(0,0,"6162",True), level="Z", pn=1), p(P(), level="A", pn=1)],1)], early=True))
print("Z err then A:", v["pk"], v["conn"], v["st"], v["rt"])
# close in the first (Z) packet
v = view(one([K(0,"A","install"), d([p(CL(True,2), level="Z", pn=1), p(P(), level="A", pn=2)],1)], early=True))
print("Z close then A:", v["pk"], v["conn"])
# Z and A share PN: accepted Z then A with same pn -> duplicate
v = view(one([K(0,"A","install"), d([p(P(), level="Z", pn=4), p(P(), level="A", pn=4)],1)], early=True))
print("shared pn:", v["pk"])
# queued Z and queued A both drained; Z install order
v = view(one([d([p(P(), level="A", pn=1)],1), d([p(P(), level="A", pn=1)],2), K(3,"A","install")]))
print("queue dup:", v["pk"])
# three packets: preflight error in middle
v = view(one([K(0,"A","install"), d([p(P(), level="Z", pn=7), p(HD(), level="Z", pn=8), p(P(), level="A", pn=9)],1)], early=True))
print("mid preflight err:", v["pk"], v["conn"])
